newsitem.title: CANADA: Gulf Canada won't up CS Resources bid.
newsitem.headline: Gulf Canada won't up CS Resources bid.

text.p: Gulf Canada Resources Ltd said on Wednesday that it would not increase its bid for CS Resources Ltd after PanCanadian Petroleum Ltd announced today it would offer C$16 a share cash for CS.

Gulf Canada Chief Executive J.P. Bryan said in a statement that Gulf Canada believed that PanCanadian's competing bid was "extremely aggressive" and very good for CS shareholders, but "far more than Gulf is willing to pay for the company."
Gulf Canada's bid of C$14.25 cash, to a maximum of C$100 million, or 1.1539 of a Gulf share for each CS share, was set to expire on July 8.
